notes.title: Release Update: New Target Date – September 30
notes.notes:
The Tale of Relm is currently in review with Steam. While that’s a big step forward, it means the game won’t release today.

Once the review is complete, I’ll still need to run final tests on the Steam build. Because Steam only allows you to change your release date once, I’ve chosen September 30 as the new target date to be sure everything is ready and working properly.

Thanks for bearing with me — we’re almost there!
